statement: Marvell guided Q3 FY2027 net revenue to $3.150 billion plus or minus 5%, for the quarter ending October 31, 2026.
why: The guided figure is above the $2.739 billion just reported, so the company expects sequential growth in AI-linked silicon revenue.

impact.mechanism: Higher vendor revenue guidance signals customers' near-term order books for custom accelerators and data-center connectivity are still expanding.

evidence.excerpt: Net revenue is expected to be $3.150 billion +/- 5%,

confidence.basis: Company press release captured at secondary tier; forward guidance carries a stated plus or minus 5% band.
